legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
legal.privacy.introduction.heading: 1. Introduction
legal.privacy.introduction.body: We value your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. This Privacy Policy explains how our platform collects, uses, discloses, and safeguards your information when you use our WhatsApp CRM services, marketing tools, landing page builders, and CRM database connections. Please read this policy carefully.
legal.privacy.collection.heading: 2. Information We Collect
legal.privacy.collection.introduction: We collect information that you directly provide to us, as well as metadata generated automatically when using our integrations. This includes:
legal.privacy.collection.account_data: Account Data: Name, professional email address, company profile information, and secure password configurations.
legal.privacy.collection.integration_set: Integration Settings: Meta developer credentials, WhatsApp Business API endpoints, API keys, and configurations for incoming webhook integrations.
legal.privacy.collection.database_syncs: Customer Database Syncs: Form inputs, phone number data logs, pipeline stage properties, and marketing campaigns content schedules.
legal.privacy.collection.usage_data: Usage Data: Technical logs, IP addresses, browser specifications, and timestamp metrics related to your interactions with our dashboards.
legal.privacy.use.heading: 3. How We Use Your Information
legal.privacy.use.introduction: We utilize the collected datasets to operate, scale, and secure our communications network:
legal.privacy.use.messaging: To dispatch, log, and render WhatsApp broadcasts and automated messaging responses.
legal.privacy.use.sync: To synchronize customer pipeline data securely between linked form integrations and lead databases.
legal.privacy.use.diagnostics: To diagnose system logs, optimize backend storage, and prevent fraudulent messaging distributions.
legal.privacy.use.billing: To process billing transactions and provide real-time updates regarding usage limit metrics.
legal.privacy.security.heading: 4. Data Retention & Security
legal.privacy.security.body: All data payloads are stored using secure cloud data architectures and encrypted both in transit (using TLS 1.3 protocols) and at rest. We store database indexes only as long as your account tier remains active. You may export or securely delete your campaign conversation records directly from your administration dashboard settings at any time.
legal.privacy.third_parties.heading: 5. Third-Party Service Integrations
legal.privacy.third_parties.body: Our platform relies on authorized integrations with WhatsApp Business APIs (Meta Platforms, Inc.), Google Cloud Services, and external payment processors. Data exchanged with these services is governed by their respective developer integration terms. We do not sell or trade user databases to external advertising aggregators.
legal.privacy.changes.heading: 6. Changes to This Policy
legal.privacy.changes.body: We reserve the right to revise this Privacy Policy periodically. Significant changes will be broadcasted to your registered workspace administrator email or displayed via service alerts. Continued utilization of our CRM tools indicates consent to updated guidelines.
legal.privacy.contact.heading: 7. Contact Information
legal.privacy.contact.body: For questions regarding data processing policies, deletion requests, or integration security compliance details, please submit an inquiry to our support center at support@throbtech.com.
legal.terms.title: Terms & Conditions
legal.terms.agreement.heading: 1. Agreement to Terms
legal.terms.agreement.body: By registering a business profile, initiating a trial tier, or accessing the messaging CRM portal, you agree to be bound by these Terms and Conditions. If you represent a company, you warrant that you possess the official authority to accept this agreement on behalf of the legal entity.
legal.terms.scope.heading: 2. Scope of Service
legal.terms.scope.body: We supply cloud-based SaaS integrations connecting lead forms, social media post planning schedules, customized landing page elements, CRM workspace pipelines, and API integrations with the WhatsApp Business Platform. The services are provided "as available." We deploy updates regularly to improve performance, structure, and security.
legal.terms.responsibilities.heading: 3. User Responsibilities & Acceptable Use
legal.terms.responsibilities.introductio: As a client administrator, you represent and warrant that:
legal.terms.responsibilities.opt_in: You will compile with WhatsApp Commerce and Business Policies regarding customer opt-ins.
legal.terms.responsibilities.spam: You will not distribute unsolicited spam broadcasts or fraudulent messaging sequences.
legal.terms.responsibilities.data: You remain solely responsible for the authenticity of the information stored inside your linked CRM databases.
legal.terms.responsibilities.credentials: You will protect access credentials and take responsibility for activities occurring under your team members' accounts.
legal.terms.billing.heading: 4. Fees, Plans, & Billing
legal.terms.billing.body: Subscription fees are charged at the beginning of each billing interval based on your selected package limits. Meta WhatsApp API usage fees are invoiced separately or calculated based on your Meta account balance. Payment defaults or failure to settle overdue billing notices within 14 business days may result in campaign execution limits or total temporary workspace suspensions.
legal.terms.ip.heading: 5. Intellectual Property
legal.terms.ip.body: All assets, code structures, interface widgets, system logos, and landing page designs are the exclusive intellectual property of our company. You receive a limited, non-assignable license to run the SaaS tools for internal corporate communications. You may not reverse-engineer, mirror, or repackage dashboard components without prior written consent.
legal.terms.liability.heading: 6. Limitation of Liability
legal.terms.liability.body: In no event shall our corporation be liable for database sync failures, third-party webhook blockages, WhatsApp phone number suspensions by Meta, loss of profits, or data leaks resulting from unsecure admin API key disclosures. Our total liability is restricted to the total amount paid by you during the three months preceding the liability claim.
legal.terms.termination.heading: 7. Account Termination
legal.terms.termination.body: You can cancel your subscription plan at any time via your account billing administration module. We retain the authority to terminate accounts immediately if customer usage triggers repeated spam violations or breaches WhatsApp developer guidelines.
legal.terms.disputes.heading: 8. Legal Disputes
legal.terms.disputes.body: These terms are governed by the local jurisdiction's corporate statutes. Any litigation arising out of these conditions shall be adjudicated exclusively within competent regional commercial courts.
